units.source_text: 我在由良旅馆逗留了三天。

en.t: I stayed at the Yura Inn for three days.

units.source_text: 促使我离开这旅馆的，是由于老板娘觉得我泊满期间一步也没有出门，

en.t: What made me leave the inn was that the proprietress thought it suspicious that during my whole stay I had not stepped outside even once,

units.source_text: 举止可疑，把警官带来了的缘故。

en.t: and so she brought a policeman because she found my behavior suspicious.

units.source_text: 我看见穿制服的警官走进我的房间里来时，

en.t: When I saw the uniformed policeman come into my room,

units.source_text: 担心我的预谋会被发现，可马上又觉得没有什么可怕的。

en.t: I worried that my plan might be discovered, but at once I felt there was nothing to fear.

units.source_text: 我据实回答了他的询问，
我说我想离开寺庙生活一段时间，所以出走了，

en.t: saying that I had run away because I wanted to leave temple life for a while,
and I showed him my student identification card.

units.source_text: 还特意当着警官的面，如数付清了旅馆负。

en.t: I also deliberately paid the inn bill in full in front of the policeman.

units.source_text: 结果，警官摆出了一副保护者的姿态，

en.t: As a result, the policeman adopted the manner of a protector,

units.source_text: 立即给商苑寺佳电话，核实我所说的不是谎言，

en.t: and immediately telephoned Shōenji to confirm that what I had said was not a lie,

units.source_text: 并告诉他们说，他将把我送回寺庙。

en.t: then told them that he would take me back to the temple.

units.source_text: 并且为了不伤害我这个有前途的人，还特意换上了便服。

en.t: And in order not to harm me, a person with prospects, he even went out of his way to change into plain clothes.
